title: P24: directory placeholders are literal {name} text
description: protocol-06 §5.1 directory values contain {targetUser}-style placeholders but never say whether they are RFC 6570 templates or how to expand them; §5.2 says only 'with any necessary percent-encoding'. Chosen: serve literal '{name}' text; clients replace each placeholder with the value percent-encoded per decision mimid-1wgh.5.18 (simple string expansion, RFC 6570 level 1 semantics). WG question filed.
